verdict.rationale: The only direct event-to-replay link is in AI Observability: each LLM trace carries the triggering user's session replay and any exceptions it threw. PostHog AI also says it can 'find the session replay', and replays themselves show errors in a synced DevTools panel. Nothing in the pack documents jumping from a funnel drop-off step, or from an error-tracking issue, to the affected users' replays. missing for 10: documented funnel drop-off → replay navigation, error-tracking issue → replay linking for general app errors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
